crime_highlights: After a trial, I found Ms. Florence guilty of second-degree murder.
she saw Mr. Milne on the floor with blood visible around him

rationale_highlights: Alcohol abuse is widely understood to be a systemic factor in the sentencing of aboriginal offenders.
Ms. Florence witnessed her father's drinking and his abuse of her mother.
I am also mindful of Ms. Florence's intention to connect with her aboriginal heritage in her efforts to continue her rehabilitation.
note: Court only says it is mindful of heritage; no explicit reduction of culpability.
